scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact result for symmetric uniform-stationary walks on equal-arm trees with at least three arms and three edges per arm; no assertion for unequal arms, varying stationary mass, directed chains or spectral-radius mixing. Computational finite checks are supporting diagnostics, not infinite proofs. Priority is assessed on accessible primary-source comparisons; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact Kemeny-optimal walks on equal-arm spiders: one interior holding junction and a degree-dependent uniformity penalty
